description: Fork of exp733 (v_lut NAP=7, val=1.3857). Two changes: residual_input_nap 6 -> 7 AND emb_resid_input_nap 6 -> 7. Residual luts (per-layer + emb_resid) get K=128. Param delta: per-layer residual +37.7M (6.29M per layer x 6), emb_resid +6.3M = +44.0M total -> 358.5M total. n_outputs=384 keeps these on the bmm-wgrad path. Tests whether residual stream LUTs benefit from wider K like v_lut did. Expected wallclock ~90-95 min.
